summary: The iOS app lists, opens and follows documents read-only, through the shared document view

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: App-only: the iOS app reads documents through the existing client routes (document.get, documents.list, document-references.get) when the daemon grants the documents capability, and says that an older st does not serve documents otherwise. No client API or daemon change.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.

manual.detail: No action is required; the phone's owner gets it with the next app build.
